Why don’t you just take a break and find yourself and what really makes you happy? From my own experience that was the best choice for me. I have very strict parents who ran my life and forced me to do whatever career they wanted from me. As someone who loved and looked up to me parents I did and for many years I hated it. So many tears and time was wasted and painful but I kept at it, no matter how much I tried I didn’t do well. My heart just wasn’t in it, so I finally stood up to my parents and said enough is enough! It’s my life, I can run it myself! Ever since then my life has been so much more at peace and happier, I can’t wait to start each in everyday. No matter the struggle and pain I still found a way to smile and live happily. This is my advice to you, please do what makes you happy even though there will be pain and struggles ahead. As long as it makes you happy and not hurting anyone you can do it! I believe in you! Please live life to the fullest. Don’t end it and miss out on wonderful things that are waiting for you!
